description_zh: Zoox AV(ego)在 Harrison Street 4 车道直行,右侧相邻 5 车道前方有一辆 Camaro(v2) 正为绕开其同车道更前方的骑行者(cyclist,cruise,纵向更远)而突然向左切入 ego 所在 4 车道,导致 v2 左前侧车身与 ego 右侧翼子板/前门擦碰(side swipe);骑行者保持在 v2 前方同车道直行,仅作为引发避让的诱因保留。

source_snippets: A Zoox vehicle (Vehicle 1) in autonomous mode was traveling in lane 4 on southwest-bound Harrison Street near Columbia Square in San Francisco.
a passenger car (Vehicle 2), traveling in the same direction ahead of the Zoox vehicle in the right adjacent lane (lane 5), was attempting to go around a cyclist, on the right side, in lane 5.
Vehicle 2 then swerved left into lane 4 across the path of the Zoox vehicle and the driver-side quarter panel on Vehicle 2 contacted the passenger-side fender and front door of the Zoox vehicle.
Both vehicles proceeded a few feet further and pulled over to exchange information.
TYPE OF COLLISION: B. SIDE SWIPE (shaded); MOVEMENT PRECEDING COLLISION: B. PROCEEDING STRAIGHT VEH 1; J. CHANGING LANES VEH 2.
WEATHER: A. CLEAR VEH 1 X, VEH 2 X; LIGHTING: A. DAYLIGHT VEH 1 X, VEH 2 X; ROADWAY SURFACE: A. DRY VEH 1 X, VEH 2 X; ROADWAY CONDITIONS: H. NO UNUSUAL CONDITIONS.
evidence.reason: Zoox AV 直行(maneuver=straight),Camaro 从右侧相邻车道(adjacent/side=right)突然左切进入 ego 车道并侧擦(cut_in,swerved→trig_ttc=1.5),碰撞为 side swipe(a=v2,b=ego);引发避让的骑行者在 v2 前方同一右侧车道保持直行,用 cruise 保留且纵向偏置(long=15)大于 v2(long=5)以避免重叠。天气 clear、路面 dry、无路口控制(control=none),时间 17:34 归为 evening。
